notes: Two kinds of license key. The terminal key licenses the computers on the floor: it is permanent and one covers the whole shop. The counter key licenses a NetPulse-Server. Neither works in place of the other, and a key pasted into the wrong box now says exactly that. The shop's own name on the screens is something a key buys; the name you set is kept and comes back the moment a key goes in. Every key issued before this build needs replacing.
